decisions.reason: The MMAK modular plant concept already has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros per year, which makes it a strong selling point to keep promoting.
Mobile slow-speed shredders are Doppstadt's core business, and this product has its own dedicated page, so dropping it within a year is very unlikely.
This modular plant concept is only mentioned on the website, so it carries some risk of being merged into Product A, but one year is short for a capital-goods solution.
Mobile trommel screens are a core part of the firm's established range and complement its shredders, so the product will likely stay.
